capabilities: create persistent highlighters from search queries or JavaScript regex
group highlighters by tags and toggle them from the command palette or hotkeys
style highlights with colors and decoration options, including capture groups and parent-line matching
highlight all occurrences of the word under the cursor or of selected text
extras: Settings imported from the original Dynamic Highlights plugin will not work; the README also notes possible remaining regex bugs and includes example queries for dialogue and multi-word highlighting.
intentEvidence: I fixed a bug in the regEx, but otherwise I left the basic mechanics untouched. I just added a lot more customisability
motivation: The author fixed a bug in the original Dynamic Highlights plugin and added more customisability and usability features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to persistently highlight text in the editor based on search queries or regular expressions.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on 'Dynamic Highlights' by @nothingislost. I fixed a bug in the regEx
Some of the highlight styles were inspired by those available in 'Highlightr' by @chetachiezikeuzor

summary: RegEx-powered text highlighter plugin that renders persistent and cursor-based highlights from search queries, grouped by tags and toggleable via commands.
